answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 23309 Country: India Title: What is the meaning of name "IFRAZ"? , i want to put it for my niece. Should i had any name before or after this name? Question: What is the meaning of name "IFRAZ"? , i want to put it for my niece. Should i had any name before or after this name? Answer ID: 23309 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 990/761/D=1431) The meaning of Ifraz is not good, it means to separate, to hunt, to provide the hunter the chance to hunt with deceit. So, do not keep this name, rather choose any name from the names of Prophet’s wives, Sahabiyat and the daughters of the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
